about: The model each kind of toolkit agent requests, by account class. Read by tests/check_models.py, which also renders the tables in README.md, references/model-roles.md and shared/commands/setup.md from this file. The reasons and Anthropic's sources are in references/model-roles.md.

reasoner.reason: Council seats, PACE players and coaches, review lenses and cross-checks. Anthropic's cost guidance says to use Sonnet for teammates.

chair.reason: The one synthesis the user reads. Opus only where the account's allowance makes its cost reasonable and /model lists it; Opus costs several times more per turn than Sonnet.

writer.reason: Daily and weekly summaries. Never Haiku: smaller models have been observed to produce inaccurate numerical figures in these summaries.

transcriber.reason: Reads rendered pages of image-only PDFs into text, extraction being one of Haiku's listed uses. On smaller plans two Haiku readers transcribe independently and scripts/check_transcription.py refuses the result unless they agree on every number, because a misread digit becomes a false citation check in /audit. Larger plans use one Sonnet reader and the same checker.
